text:
Maya S.: Quick help — customer asking for our CAIQ answers plus a plain-English shared responsibility summary for encryption/KMS during their POC. Also want an estimate for Dedicated capacity cost for a 2-week POC. Can someone own?

Raj (Sec): I can take the CAIQ review. Need the customer's scope (regions, data residency) and whether they want customer-managed keys (CMK) or Redwood KMS.

Lia (SE): POC infra note: if they want Dedicated GPUs in us-west + CMK, we'll need a private VPC peering or Private deployment option. That affects cost.

Tom (Eng-SE): For pricing, we usually quote a short-term Dedicated uplift: base reserved rate prorated + burst buffer. I can sketch numbers once we know GPU type and qps.

Maya S.: They said: EU and US, low qps (~5 rps), prefer CMK, and will test 8k token gen. POC is 2 weeks starting next Monday.

security-bot: CAIQ template link: https://redwood.internal/caas/templates/caqi-2025-v1 (last updated 2025-01-08)

Raj (Sec): Draft shared-resp bullets (for customer-facing doc):
```
- Red: Redwood manages model serving runtime, physical hosts, and kernel-level optimizations.
- Yellow: Customer is responsible for data ingress, API keys in their app, and KMS key material if CMK selected.
- Green: If CMK is enabled, Redwood will integrate but will not have ability to decrypt customer-encrypted payloads without explicit key rotation policies from customer.
```

Lia (SE): Also add this operational note to CAIQ answer for encryption: "We support TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, and offer CMK with Cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). Logs with PII can be forwarded to customer log buckets; default retention 30d unless enterprise policy set."

Tom (Eng-SE): For the Dedicated POC estimate (rough): 1x A10G-equivalent pool reserved for 2 weeks + S3 storage + egress = ~USD 18k. If they drop to shared-hosted with CMK, cost could be ~USD 3k. I'll make a formal quote.

Maya S.: This is great. Raj, can you attach the CAIQ export with red/amber/green flags? Lia, please add the POC infra note and a short runbook. Tom, formalize the POC quote and options (Dedicated vs Hosted-with-CMK).

Raj (Sec): Will do. ETA EOD today.

Lia (SE): Will draft runbook this afternoon.

Tom (Eng-SE): I'll put numbers in a spreadsheet and ping for review.

Maya S.: Thanks team — I'll update the customer with a 48h turnaround expectation. :thumbsup:
